source: National Archives Constitution Amendment XVIII Section 2
review_notes: Codex reviewed the full shared-power clause; Congress and the several States have separate concurrent enforcement powers. The provision was inspected during parser development.
text:
AMENDMENT XVIII
Section 2.
The Congress and the several States shall have concurrent power to enforce this article by appropriate legislation.
